newsitem.title: USA: Trump, Rank talks on - Trump official.
newsitem.headline: Trump, Rank talks on - Trump official.

text.p: Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc and Britain's Rank Organisation Plc are still in negotiations surrounding the latter's planned $50 million investment in Atlantic City's Trump Castle hotel and casino, a Trump official said on Friday.
"We're still negotiating as far as I'm concerned and there's nothing public about any pullback on the deal," the official said.
The official quashed news reports on Friday morning that said Rank would not follow through on the investment.

The investment is expected to be used to renovate the Trump Castle into a Hard Rock Hotel and Casino, with the two companies sharing in the profits, sources said. The deal was expected to be announced at a November 19 press conference that was ultimately postponed due to "logistical" reasons.
"It's taken a little bit longer than we thought but I don't know that (Rank has pulled out), the official said.

Trump Castle's high-yielding debt dropped about six points in thin post-holiday trade after newswires indicated the erosion in negotiations, traders said. Trump shares dropped 1/2 point to 14-1/8 on Friday afternoon.
Rank Organisation could not be reached for comment.
